"""Minimal restaurant inventory + par-level reorder prototype.

Usage: python3 inventory.py sample.csv
CSV columns: item,supplier,on_hand,par_level,unit_cost
"""
import csv
import sys
from dataclasses import dataclass


@dataclass
class Item:
    name: str
    supplier: str
    on_hand: float
    par_level: float
    unit_cost: float

    def order_qty(self) -> float:
        return max(0.0, self.par_level - self.on_hand)

    def order_cost(self) -> float:
        return round(self.order_qty() * self.unit_cost, 2)


def load(path: str) -> list[Item]:
    with open(path, newline="") as f:
        return [
            Item(r["item"], r["supplier"], float(r["on_hand"]),
                 float(r["par_level"]), float(r["unit_cost"]))
            for r in csv.DictReader(f)
        ]


def reorder_by_supplier(items: list[Item]) -> dict[str, list[Item]]:
    out: dict[str, list[Item]] = {}
    for it in items:
        if it.order_qty() > 0:
            out.setdefault(it.supplier, []).append(it)
    return out


def main(path: str) -> None:
    items = load(path)
    orders = reorder_by_supplier(items)
    total = 0.0
    for supplier, lines in sorted(orders.items()):
        print(f"\n== {supplier} ==")
        for it in lines:
            print(f"  {it.name:<20} order {it.order_qty():>5.1f}  (${it.order_cost():.2f})")
            total += it.order_cost()
    print(f"\nTotal order value: ${total:.2f}")
    # food-cost snapshot: value of stock currently on hand
    stock = sum(it.on_hand * it.unit_cost for it in items)
    print(f"Stock on hand value: ${stock:.2f}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main(sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else "sample.csv")
EOF

"""Minimal restaurant inventory + par-level reorder prototype.

Usage: python3 inventory.py sample.csv
CSV columns: item,supplier,on_hand,par_level,unit_cost
"""
import csv
import sys
from dataclasses import dataclass


@dataclass
class Item:
    name: str
    supplier: str
    on_hand: float
    par_level: float
    unit_cost: float

    def order_qty(self) -> float:
        return max(0.0, self.par_level - self.on_hand)

    def order_cost(self) -> float:
        return round(self.order_qty() * self.unit_cost, 2)


def load(path: str) -> list[Item]:
    with open(path, newline="") as f:
        return [
            Item(r["item"], r["supplier"], float(r["on_hand"]),
                 float(r["par_level"]), float(r["unit_cost"]))
            for r in csv.DictReader(f)
        ]


def reorder_by_supplier(items: list[Item]) -> dict[str, list[Item]]:
    out: dict[str, list[Item]] = {}
    for it in items:
        if it.order_qty() > 0:
            out.setdefault(it.supplier, []).append(it)
    return out


def main(path: str) -> None:
    items = load(path)
    orders = reorder_by_supplier(items)
    total = 0.0
    for supplier, lines in sorted(orders.items()):
        print(f"\n== {supplier} ==")
        for it in lines:
            print(f"  {it.name:<20} order {it.order_qty():>5.1f}  (${it.order_cost():.2f})")
            total += it.order_cost()
    print(f"\nTotal order value: ${total:.2f}")
    # food-cost snapshot: value of stock currently on hand
    stock = sum(it.on_hand * it.unit_cost for it in items)
    print(f"Stock on hand value: ${stock:.2f}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main(sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else "sample.csv")
